essence: The verse presents a twofold state oriented toward the divider.
He who grasps by power and worships according to rule is my portion.
Through contemplation of this, that reality is made one with one's own self in the mind.
The section closes with the marker thirty-six and the mantra oṃ-tat-sat.
My portion is consciousness by nature, namely the Lord.
